summary: # Testing in Limbo Limbo supports a comprehensive testing system to ensure correctness, performance, and compatibility with SQLite. ## 1. Compatibility Tests The `make test` target is the main entry point. Most compatibility tests live in the testing/ directory and are written in SQLite’s TCL test format. These tests ensure that Limbo matches SQLite’s behavior exactly.
